title: 第九章 谋女郎?舟女郎！
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“行舟哥！”

虽然被怪哥哥的眼神盯着有些不自在，但刘浩纯还是抬起头大大方方地冲他一笑，脆生生地喊了一声哥。

她虽然年纪不大，但也知道这是求职现场，要大大方方地。

没准考察从他盯着自己就已经开始了。

机会是学姐给的，但还是要自己争取。

“很高兴认识你，浩纯。”

苏行舟伸出手和她握了握。

这一幕被旁边的五百导演看到了，不由得侧目转身，眼神好奇的凑过来问道：

“苏总，这是你找的小演员？”

说着，他下意识地又多打量了两眼刘浩纯。

他在导演界也混了这么多年了，见过形形色色的人，很少看到这么有灵气的孩子。

这个年纪的孩子，不怯场就不错了。

可眼前的这个小女孩的眼睛圆又亮，小鹿眼干净得一尘不染，眉眼间全是未经雕琢的灵气。

干净又鲜活。

这样的苗子，属于是多少导演打着灯笼也找不到的。

五百见猎心喜，虽然苏行舟还没决定用刘浩纯，但他心里已经在琢磨该怎么拍了。

“这孩子是雪姐的学妹，在北舞附中上学。”

苏行舟看着五百的反应，笑了笑道。

“嗷，北舞附中的学生啊，难怪。”

五百了然，从小练舞的孩子气质身段确实不一般。

李雪不也是这样，北舞毕业的她从来没学过表演，只是报了个演员班也够用了。

五百被启发到了，以后可以多去舞蹈类院校找演员。

大家都是业内人士，刘浩纯的条件有多好一眼便知。

要不然她也不会被后世戏称为国师张emo的“亲妈”了。

上一世，以专业第一成绩考入北舞民族民间舞系的刘浩纯被张emo从三千人种选中，成为《一秒钟》的女主“刘闺女”。

淘汰3000人成为谋女郎，足以说明她的天赋有多高。

她的后续发展也没有辜负“谋女郎”这个名头。

《一秒钟》上映一炮而红，获亚洲电影大奖最佳新人。

《送你一朵小红花》票房14亿，马小远提名金鸡奖最佳女主。

她在里面的表演都没有拖后腿，惊艳全国观众。

人人都知道又出了一个天赋强劲的谋女郎。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Brother Xingzhou!"

Although he was a little uncomfortable being stared at by the strange brother, Liu Haochun still raised his head, smiled at him openly, and called him "brother".

Although she is young, she also knows that this is a job hunting site and she needs to be generous and generous.

Maybe the investigation started when he stared at her.

Opportunities are given by senior students, but you still have to fight for them yourself.

"Nice to meet you, Haochun."

Su Xingzhou reached out and shook her hand.

This scene was seen by the director of Wubai next to him. He couldn't help but turn around and came over with curious eyes and asked:

"Mr. Su, is this the young actor you are looking for?"

As he said that, he subconsciously took another look at Liu Haochun.

He has been in the directing world for so many years and has met all kinds of people, but it is rare to see such an energetic child.

For children of this age, it would be good if they don’t have stage fright.

But the eyes of the little girl in front of her were round and bright, her deer eyes were spotlessly clean, and her brows and eyes were full of uncarved aura.

Clean and fresh.

Such a seedling is something that no amount of directors can find even with a lantern.

Wu Bai was delighted to see Hunter Xin. Although Su Xingzhou hadn't decided to use Liu Haochun yet, he was already thinking about how to shoot it.

"This child is Sister Xue's junior high school student. She goes to Beiwu High School."

Su Xingzhou looked at Wubai's reaction and smiled.

"Oh, you are a student of Beiwu High School, no wonder."

It is obvious that the temperament and figure of a child who has practiced dancing since childhood is indeed extraordinary.

The same is true for Li Xue. After graduating from Beijing Dance University, she had never studied acting. She just signed up for an acting class and it was enough.

Wubai was inspired to go to more dance schools to look for actors in the future.

Everyone is an industry insider, and you can tell at a glance how good Liu Haochun's conditions are.

Otherwise, she would not be dubbed as the "real mother" of the national master Zhang emo by later generations.

In the last life, Liu Haochun, who was admitted to the National Folk Dance Department of Beijing Dance University with the first grade in her major, was selected by Zhang Emo from 3,000 people to become the heroine "Liu's daughter" in "One Second".

Eliminating 3,000 people to become a girl is enough to show how talented she is.

Her subsequent development also lived up to the name "Mou Girl".

"One Second" was an instant hit after its release and won the Asian Film Award for Best Newcomer.

"A Little Red Flower for You" has a box office of 1.4 billion, and Ma Xiaoyuan was nominated for the Golden Rooster Award for Best Actress.

Her performance in it was not held back, astonishing audiences across the country.

Everyone knows that another talented girl has emerged.
